title: Season Launch System
description: A four-image reference-dependent kit that establishes one season-opening campaign language for a fictional league or tournament.
creative_direction: Image 01 defines the opening-season visual universe, cast hierarchy, neutral league branding grammar, and schedule-ready layout. Images 02-04 depend on that anchor while adapting the same system to schedule, star-cast, and trophy-countdown surfaces.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-division-schedule-board, 03-star-cast-poster, 04-trophy-countdown-variant. Queue may run 02-division-schedule-board, 03-star-cast-poster, 04-trophy-countdown-variant concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
